items.subject: Shodan indexes over 47.000 exposed Ollama instances
items.what_happened: A Shodan scan reportedly indexes over 47,000 Ollama instances reachable on the public internet, which by default expose unauthenticated API endpoints allowing model listing, pulling, deletion, and inference. Operators should verify OLLAMA_HOST binding, keep port 11434 off public interfaces, and place any external access behind an authenticating reverse proxy or VPN. Note: the source is a single social media post, so the figure is unverified.
